about: A research run at 'started'. The workflow wrote one light research note into Research/ before the writer stopped it; no outcomes file was saved. `mark --stopped` exits 0, edits no note (both requests stay `- [r]`, no link line), leaves the research note where it is, and saves `stopped: true` on the open run, which moves to 'marked', waiting for flags-1.
readings: `stopped` sits after the open run's other keys; key order doesn't matter to the comparison.
Where "You stopped this run." is saved isn't fixed by the spec (CONTRACT.md 4 item 1 says only that the reason is saved for the log), so case 235 checks it in the log.
